description: Hear a Starchild song in a different production style (for example Country, Acoustic Indie, Electro Rock, Latin Salsa, Piano Ballad Orchestral). Returns a link that opens the song on starchild.music set to that style, with the original vocal. Lists the available styles if the requested one isn't made for this song.

song.description: Song id, starchild.music/songs/... link, or exact title

name: change_style
title: Hear it in another style
